target_description: The EP-21 lab guest: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS on the distribution kernel, booted from a fresh overlay on the pristine cloud image, reached over ssh on the host's port 2222. It is a stock kernel and it governs nothing; the harness's only lawful use of it is --capture. Brought up with ~/gov-lab/m0-up.sh and down with ~/gov-lab/m0-down.sh (planning/vm/M0-EVIDENCE.md §9). It is disposable: the `clean` snapshot is the baseline to return to.
